privacy_policy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy_policy.introduction:
This Privacy Policy explains how Growlane ("we", "us", or "our"), a digital marketing and web development agency operating in India, collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit thegrowlane.com or engage our services.

By using our website or contacting us, you agree to the terms described in this policy.

sections.title: INFORMATION WE COLLECT
sections.content: We may collect the following types of information:

subsections.heading: a) Information you provide directly:
points: Full name
Email address
Phone number / WhatsApp number
Business name and type
Any messages or enquiries you send us

subsections.heading: b) Information collected automatically:
points: IP address
Browser type and version
Pages visited on our website
Time and date of your visit
Referring website or source

subsections.heading: c) Information from third-party tools:
points: Google Analytics (website traffic and behaviour)
Meta Pixel (if running ad campaigns for clients)
WhatsApp Business (messages you send us directly)

sections.title: HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION
sections.content: We use the information we collect to:
points: Respond to your enquiries and consultation requests
Provide and manage our services to you
Send project updates, proposals, and invoices
Improve our website and service offerings
Send occasional updates about Growlane (you may opt out at any time)
Comply with applicable Indian laws and regulations
sections.note: We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.title: HOW WE SHARE YOUR INFORMATION
sections.content: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party.
points: With trusted service providers (e.g. hosting, email, analytics tools) strictly to operate our business
When required by law, court order, or government authority under applicable Indian law
With your explicit written consent
sections.note: All third-party tools we use are bound by their own privacy policies and data protection standards.

sections.title: DATA STORAGE AND SECURITY
sections.content:
Your data is stored securely on trusted cloud platforms. We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, loss, or misuse.

However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by law.

sections.title: YOUR RIGHTS UNDER INDIAN LAW
sections.content: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and applicable Indian regulations, you have the right to:
points: Access the personal data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Request deletion of your personal data
Withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent)
Nominate a representative to exercise rights on your behalf
sections.contact:
To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at: hello@thegrowlane.com

We will respond to your request within 30 days.

sections.title: COOKIES
sections.content: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.

subsections.heading: We use cookies for:
points: Understanding how visitors use our website (analytics)
Remembering your preferences

sections.note: You can disable cookies through your browser settings at any time. Note that some parts of the website may not function correctly if cookies are disabled.

sections.title: THIRD-PARTY LINKS
sections.content: Our website may contain links to third-party websites (e.g. social media platforms, partner tools). We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies separately.

sections.title: CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
sections.content: Our website and services are not directed at children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with their information, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
sections.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.

We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
